env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt


logos eject -o out

exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
exists out/assets/z.txt
exists out/testdata/keep.txt

# Dot and underscore trees are not packages, but they are module files:
# //go:embed can reach them, so they must be copied.
exists out/.cache/x.txt
exists out/_scratch/y.txt
exists out/.hidden.txt
exists out/_data.txt
exists out/static/.well-known/x.txt

# A directory holding its own go.mod is another module and stays out,
# including one nested under testdata.
! exists out/other
! exists out/other/go.mod
! exists out/testdata/nested
! exists out/.git

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cp stdout $WORK/ejected.txt
cmp $WORK/native.txt $WORK/ejected.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectscope

go 1.27
-- m/main.lgo --
// Command ejectscope exercises eject over a module tree that holds
// foreign directories.
package main

import (
	_ "embed"
	"fmt"
)

//go:embed _data.txt
var data string

//go:embed .hidden.txt
var hidden string

//go:embed all:static
var static string

func main() {
	fmt.Print(data)
	fmt.Print(hidden)
	fmt.Print(static)
	fmt.Println("scoped eject")
}
-- m/_data.txt --
underscore data

-- m/.hidden.txt --
hidden data

-- m/static/.well-known/x.txt --
well-known

-- m/other/go.mod --
module example.com/foreign

go 1.27
-- m/other/foreign.go --
package foreign
-- m/.cache/x.txt --
cache
-- m/_scratch/y.txt --
scratch
-- m/assets/z.txt --
asset
-- m/testdata/keep.txt --
kept
-- m/testdata/nested/go.mod --
module example.com/testdata-nested

go 1.27
-- m/testdata/nested/inner.go --
package inner
